summary: Reconstructs a color image with optional geometry and temporal guidance.
summaryText: Reconstructs a color image with optional geometry and temporal guidance.
remarks: Geometry guidance is independent of the lighting technique. For standalone image-only sources, set UseHrcGeometry and UseGeometryGuidance to false before initialization. Call ResetHistory after scene cuts. Use [`UDRQuality`](<xref:UDRQuality>) for resolution presets.
